judgment: Seek to see the great person.
image: Trees grow up inside the earth: Climbing.
So the noble one follows virtue duly,
piling the small up into the high and great.
lines: Trust — then it is good to use
The king offers on Mount Qi.
good in nothing but unceasing holding firm.

notes.name_en: 升 is rising/climbing by steps; 'Climbing', not Wilhelm's 'Pushing Upward'.
notes.judgment: 用見大人 'seek to see' per glossary, distinct from 利見大人; 亨 in L4 reads 享 'offers'.
